traditional: A soft contact. Love, money, and pleasure supports action, conflict, and heat - cooperation and favorable conditions in these areas. The benefic Venus tempers the malefic Mars.
modern: Attraction meets drive. Desire, and the channeling of energy into pleasure, art, or pursuit. The conjunction can either fuse charm and drive or have the two cancel out. The sextile makes this a natural strength: Popularity and energy that flows easily into creative or romantic pursuits. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: A chance to organize connection and drive into a new form; it must be actively taken up.
cyclic.waning: Reorganize and share what connection and drive have taught; communicate the insight.

business: An opening in this area. Charm plus initiative; manage the push-pull between attraction and aggression.
shadow: The ease lets indulgence and vanity and anger and recklessness go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: A supportive opening becomes available; offered, not automatic.
arcSeparating: The opening closes; unused, it passes.

readerCopy.body: A stalled agreement may move once somebody makes a direct offer the other side can actually answer. Venus sextile Mars can turn vague interest into a price, date, role, boundary, or next step without making the whole exchange confrontational. Do not make the other person guess what action would keep the deal alive. Say what is being offered and what response is needed. One specific move is enough to test if the interest is mutual before anyone spends more time negotiating with a possibility.
